## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
CAUTION — Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; confirmed by weak overall breadth and narrow leadership (Top 5 concentrated in Technology: 4/5), indicating mixed signals and the need to reduce risk gradually.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +9.77% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +5.83%) ABOVE TREND. Technology is showing pockets of strength: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Materials and Consumer Staples are weakest: CRH (1W: -11.00% | 1M: -13.15%) BELOW TREND, PPG (1W: -13.44% | 1M: -14.80%) BELOW TREND, EL (1W: -15.30% | 1M: -22.24%) BELOW TREND. Financials and Industrials show broad weakness as well: JPM (1W: -3.60% | 1M: -8.76%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -8.34% | 1M: -1.58%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +12.63%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +10.83% | 1M: -1.00%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: EL (1W: -15.30% | 1M: -22.24%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -14.67% | 1M: -4.87%) BELOW TREND, F (1W: -13.77% | 1M: -11.13%) BELOW TREND, PPG (1W: -13.44% | 1M: -14.80%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -12.81% | 1M: -4.04%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated and broad across Materials/Staples.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Best 1W movers: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +12.63%) ABOVE TREND; watch PANW (1W: +10.83% | 1M: -1.00%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL for follow-through and IBM (1W: +7.76% | 1M: -9.94%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL as a short-term bounce.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed: pockets of strong winners but meaningful dispersion — INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +8.08% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND versus AAPL (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND and GOOGL (1W: -4.25% | 1M: -10.37%) BELOW TREND; sector is showing internal rotation with selective accumulation.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Soft and broadly negative: JPM (1W: -3.60% | 1M: -8.76%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -0.87% | 1M: -3.62%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: +0.99% | 1M: -5.63%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — sector under pressure, limited leadership.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Defensive names mixed with signs of profit-taking: JNJ (1W: -3.23% | 1M: +3.07%) TREND EXHAUSTION, UNH (1W: -2.32% | 1M: +3.83%) TREND EXHAUSTION, LLY (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -10.40%) BELOW TREND — cautious stance as headlines create divergence.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor selective exposure to Energy and proven Technology winners while reducing exposure to weak Materials/Staples names; with CAUTION and narrow leadership, prioritize names with confirmed above-trend action (e.g., MPC, INTU, NOW) and reduce exposure to stocks showing broad distribution or confirmed below-trend action.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ASML (1W: -10.88% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND, MNST (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +3.17% | 1M: +8.83%) showing strength and leadership potential. BEARISH: Materials (1W: -6.92% | 1M: -5.40%) and Consumer Staples (1W: -5.38% | 1M: -2.76%) remain under pressure.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch INTU for continuation above recent breakout (INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND) and MPC to confirm energy leadership (MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND); monitor ASML (1W: -10.88% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND as a risk trigger for tech capex names and PFE (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +1.01%) TREND EXHAUSTION for sentiment-driven moves.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
INTU (+65): INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND — news (strong Q2, dividend hike, Anthropic deal) confirming the price move (accumulation). PFE (+80): PFE (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +1.01%) TREND EXHAUSTION — positive China/cancer headlines but 1W weakness signals divergence; monitor for follow-through. AMAT (+55): AMAT (1W: -12.77% | 1M: +9.26%) TREND EXHAUSTION — positive sentiment on AI chip equipment yet sharp 1W drop suggests distribution.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
MNST (-55): MNST (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND — negative earnings reaction confirming price weakness. WMT (-55): WMT (1W: -3.24% | 1M: -3.28%) BELOW TREND — downgrade/FTC headline confirming continued pressure. ORCL (-65): ORCL not in detailed list; monitor for follow-through if price data shows weakness versus the negative narrative.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; Leadership: Narrow (Top 5 concentrated 4/5 in Technology). INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND and VLO (1W: +9.77% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk is narrow leadership and headline-driven divergences (AMAT (1W: -12.77% | 1M: +9.26%) TREND EXHAUSTION, PFE (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +1.01%) TREND EXHAUSTION) — monitor sentiment for confirmation.
